{"consolidated_memory":"## Crash Loop Issues in infra/k8s/deployment.yaml

**File:** infra/k8s/deployment.yaml (infrastructure, Kubernetes deployment manifest)  
**Common Pattern:** All three incidents manifested as container restart a few seconds after start when rolling out to the small node pool. All covered by manifest lint and dry run checks in CI. Stack is YAML.

---

### Incident 1: [2026-02-23] Floating Point Rounding in Money Path
- **Trigger/Symptom:** Crash loop occurred only for users in negative UTC offset timezones
- **Root Cause:** Floating point rounding error in the money calculation path
- **Fix:** Moved arithmetic from floating point to integer minor units (cents/smallest currency units)
- **PR:** #6081 on branch fix/crash-loop-1
- **Result:** Nightly rollup matched source counts for 10 consecutive days

### Incident 2: [2026-07-06] Unbounded Retry Loop with No Backoff
- **Trigger/Symptom:** Crash loop appeared only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- **Root Cause:** Unbounded retry loop with no backoff mechanism
- **Fix:** Capped retry attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- **PR:** #6990 on branch fix/crash-loop-2
- **Result:** Cold start latency dropped 18 percent, down to 364 ms

### Incident 3: [2026-08-20] Listener Not Unregistered on Teardown
- **Trigger/Symptom:** Crash loop occurred only on first request after a cold start
- **Root Cause:** Event listener registered but never removed during teardown
- **Fix:** Removed the listener on teardown and added test assertion to prevent regression
- **PR:** #7682 on branch fix/crash-loop-3
- **Result:** Flaky test improved from 68 failures per hundred runs to zero"}
